backend/main.mo: Main actor defining user profiles, production records, dispatch records, operations (1-17), and daily operation production with CRUD functions and access control integration.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that initializes 17 predefined operations (Boxing, Welding/Finishing, Rear Wall, etc.) with sequential IDs 1-17 on actor upgrade.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three requirements: displaying all 17 operations in order 1-17 in entry/dashboard/history pages, and validating operation IDs 1-17 on save.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Summary descriptions of all frontend components including pages (Dashboard, ProductionEntry, ProductionHistory, Dispatch, WorkInHand, ContainerDailyReport), layout, auth, and query hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes including industrial color palette and sidebar styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts, dark mode body class, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for production dashboard, history, and container daily report pages, all wrapped with AuthGuard and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component with login button displayed to unauthenticated users attempting to access protected routes.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard that checks login status and role, redirects non-admin users from restricted routes to production dashboard, and shows profile setup modal for new users.
frontend/src/components/ControlBar.tsx: Control bar component displaying facility name, real-time clock, and operational status indicator with live updates every second.
frontend/src/components/DailyProductionR: Filter component for daily production reports with date range and operation selection, using shadcn/ui components and the useGetAllOperations hook.
Sortable table component displaying daily production reports with columns for date, operation, production metrics, and edit functionality (disabled for viewer role).
frontend/src/components/DispatchVsProduc: Line chart component using Recharts to visualize and compare daily production vs dispatch data over the last 30 days.
Button component that simulates PDF export functionality with loading state and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner component with animated counter displaying monthly production total and gradient background effects.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header, role-based navigation (desktop and mobile), authentication integration, and Internet Identity support.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyTargetCar: Card component displaying monthly production target progress with animated progress bar and color-coded status indicators.
frontend/src/components/OperationalInsig: Displays four key operational metrics (average daily output, capacity utilization, production efficiency, estimated monthly output) in card format with animated progress bars and conditional styling.
frontend/src/components/OperationCompari: Renders a bar chart comparing total completed production across all operations, using Recharts with animated bars colored by gradient based on completion percentage.
frontend/src/components/PresentationMode: Button component that toggles presentation mode on/off using context, displaying different icons and text based on current state.
frontend/src/components/ProductionDashbo: Displays a sortable table of all operations with today's production, total completed, despatch, and in-hand quantities, highlighting recently updated rows with a glow effect.
frontend/src/components/ProductionTrendC: Renders a line chart showing daily production trends over the last 30 days, aggregating production data by date using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup, prompting for name input with form validation and loading state during save.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a metric with animated counter effect, icon, and optional description, supporting multiple visual variants (default, primary, success, warning).
frontend/src/contexts/PresentationModeCo: React context provider for managing global presentation mode state with toggle functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateDailyProduct: React Query mutation hook for creating daily production reports via the actor, invalidating related queries on success and showing error toasts on failure.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDailyProduct: React Query hook that fetches all daily production reports, enriches them with operation details and dynamically calculated total completed values, with auto-refresh every 30 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllOperations.t: React Query hook that fetches all operations from the actor with 5-minute stale time and retry logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerRole.ts: React Query hook that fetches the caller's user role from the actor, handling loading states for both actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the caller's user profile from the actor, returning null if no profile exists.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks if the caller has admin privileges via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useMonthlyProductionM: Hook that calculates monthly production metrics including total produced, completion percentage, daily average, capacity utilization, and efficiency based on a 100-container monthly target.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Consolidated file containing React Query hooks for user profile operations (get, save) and admin check functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving the caller's user profile, invalidating the profile query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateDailyProduct: React Query mutation hook for updating daily production reports by ID, invalidating queries on success and showing error toasts on failure.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom dark industrial theme using deep navy backgrounds, electric blue accents, and container red highlights, plus utility classes for tables and metrics cards.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportE: Page component for entering and editing daily production reports per operation, with date selection, global despatch input, and automatic calculation of total completed values.
frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportP: Displays a daily production report table for all 17 operations with date selector, showing today's production, total completed, despatch, and calculated in-hand inventory (Total Completed - Despatch).
frontend/src/pages/ProductionDashboardPa: Main production dashboard with hero section, KPI summary cards, tabbed interface for dashboard/insights views, charts (production trend, operation comparison, dispatch vs production), monthly metrics, and presentation mode with PDF export.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionHistoryPage: Displays filterable production history with date range and operation filters, shows read-only access notice for viewer roles, and renders production records in a table.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom industrial theme colors (Deep Navy, Steel Grey, Container Red, Electric Blue, Industrial Green), OKLCH color system, custom shadows, fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a responsive container manufacturing production control platform with dark industrial theme, featuring dashboard, KPI cards, charts, presentation mode, PDF export, role-based access, and 17-operation daily report structure.
